# debezium Provider



## Example Usage

```terraform
provider "debezium" {
  endpoint = "https://connect.example.com:8083"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `endpoint` (String) Base URL of the Kafka Connect REST API used to manage Debezium connectors (e.g. `https://connect.example.com:8083`). Can also be set via the `DEBEZIUM_CONNECT_ENDPOINT` environment variable; the attribute takes precedence when both are set.
